# IYAKKI boot configuration for the Raspberry Pi 5 with the IYAKKI boot loader. Written by iyakki-usb; an update rewrites it. Do not edit by hand: put your own
# lines in config-user.txt (included last). The firmware starts U-Boot, U-Boot starts the loader (EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI), the loader starts the kernel.
[all]
arm_64bit=1
kernel=u-boot.bin
device_tree=bcm2712-rpi-5-b.dtb
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2
enable_uart=1
uart_2ndstage=1
disable_splash=1
include config-user.txt
